consumer_label.en: Kanni and Kanya share a solar-ingress family but use distinct calendar authority
consumer_label.hi: कन्नि और कन्या एक सौर-प्रवेश family साझा करते हैं पर calendar authority अलग है

scope.statement: The reviewed lanes share a material-free solar-transition, story and safety core. Malayalam Kanni and North/shared Kanya retain distinct regional naming and accepted calendar/date authority even when a sampled civil date matches.

evidence_refs.claim_scope: Reviewed reusable practice core and distinct applicability.
Malayalam timing authority must not be collapsed into North/shared Kanya.

consumer_label.en: Bengal Vishwakarma Puja is a separate workplace route
consumer_label.hi: बंगाल विश्वकर्मा पूजा अलग workplace route है

scope.statement: A sampled calendar may show Vishwakarma Puja on the Kanni date, but Bengal workplace tools, machinery, organiser and shutdown/restart safety are not Kerala Kanni household practice.

evidence_refs.claim_scope: Existing owner for materially distinct workplace practice.
Date overlap does not merge procedure.

consumer_label.en: Agastya teaches Rama the Aditya Hridaya
consumer_label.hi: अगस्त्य राम को आदित्य हृदय सिखाते हैं

scope.statement: The Kanni pack reuses Yuddha Kanda 6.107 as an optional complete Surya story, not as Kanni Sankramam's origin, a generic mantra instruction, real-person enemy metaphor or result guarantee.
scope.source_expression_scope: IIT Kanpur Valmiki Ramayan Sanskrit and translation, Yuddha Kanda 6.107

evidence_refs.claim_scope: Complete Agastya-Rama battlefield teaching and attributed results.
The ritual pack summarises but does not own or prescribe the epic chapter.
